description: Install framer-motion for animations and update tailwind.config.js content paths to include pages/ and features/ directories. Verify the project builds cleanly after changes.
steps: Run `npm install framer-motion` in the project root to add the animation library
Edit tailwind.config.js to add './pages/**/*.{ts,tsx}' and './features/**/*.{ts,tsx}' to the content array (currently only has index.html, index.tsx, App.tsx, and components/)
Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` to verify the project compiles without errors
acceptance_criteria: framer-motion is listed in package.json dependencies
tailwind.config.js content array includes pages/ and features/ globs
